definitions.explanation: The head of the Roman Catholic Church, the Bishop of Rome, who lives in Vatican City. Usually called ローマ{教皇|きょうこう}.

examples.japanese: {教皇|きょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{教皇|きょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new pope has been chosen.

examples.japanese: ローマ{教皇|きょうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バチカン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: At the Vatican, the Pope issued a message appealing for peace.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
{法王|ほうおう} (ローマ{法王|ほうおう}) was long the usual word in Japanese newspapers. In 2019 the Japanese government switched to {教皇|きょうこう}, the term the Catholic Church in Japan prefers, and most media followed; both are still heard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ローマ{教皇|きょうこう}: the Pope
- {教皇|きょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be elected pope
- {教皇|きょうこう}{庁|ちょう}: the Holy See
